name: VirtualTradePad v4.0
summary: VirtualTradePad is a multi-function trading panel/dashboard EA for MT5 that provides a graphical interface for manual trading operations including opening/closing positions, placing pending orders, trailing stops, and monitoring account info across up to 6 symbols. It does not generate its own trade signals but instead offers button-driven controls for the trader to execute trades manually from the chart.
summary_zh: VirtualTradePad是一个MT5多功能交易面板/仪表盘EA，提供图形界面用于手动交易操作，包括开仓/平仓、挂单、移动止损和监控最多6个交易品种的账户信息。它不生成自己的交易信号，而是提供按钮驱动控件让交易者从图表上手动执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不是一个自动交易策略，而是一个交易工具面板。它的核心功能是通过图表上的按钮界面让交易者手动执行买卖操作、平仓（全部平仓、只平盈利、只平亏损、只平多单、只平空单等）、设置挂单（BUYSTOP、SELLSTOP、BUYLIMIT、SELLLIMIT）、修改止损止盈、反向操作以及移动止损。仓位管理完全由交易者手动控制，通过按钮调整手数（每次增减0.01）、止损止盈点数和挂单距离。资金管理方面，提供了基于利润/亏损自动平仓的功能（USEProfitCLOSE），支持按美元、百分比或点数三种方式设置平仓条件。该面板还集成了11个技术指标的显示切换功能，包括MA、MACD、RSI、布林带等，以及多时间周期图表切换功能，方便交易者进行技术分析。总体而言，这是一个半自动化的交易辅助工具，所有交易决策仍需人工判断。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an automated trading strategy but rather a comprehensive trading panel utility. Its core functionality provides a chart-based button interface allowing traders to manually execute buy/sell operations, close positions (close all, close profitable only, close losing only, close buys only, close sells only, etc.), place pending orders (BUYSTOP, SELLSTOP, BUYLIMIT, SELLLIMIT), modify stop loss and take profit levels, reverse positions, and apply trailing stops. Position sizing is entirely manual, controlled via buttons that increment/decrement lot size by 0.01, along with adjustable SL/TP pip values and pending order distance levels. For money management, it offers an auto-close feature (USEProfitCLOSE) that can close positions based on profit/loss thresholds in three modes: dollar amount, percentage, or points. The panel also integrates display toggling for 11 technical indicators including MA, MACD, RSI, Bollinger Bands, and others, plus multi-timeframe chart switching capability for technical analysis. Overall, this is a semi-automated trading assistant where all trading decisions still require human judgment.
pros: 集成了丰富的交易功能于一身：开平仓、挂单、移动止损、反向操作、利润自动平仓等
支持同时监控6个交易品种，方便多品种交易管理
内置11个技术指标切换和多时间周期图表功能，交易与技术分析一体化
pros_en: Integrates a rich set of trading functions in one panel: open/close positions, pending orders, trailing stops, reverse operations, and profit-based auto-close
Supports monitoring up to 6 symbols simultaneously for convenient multi-instrument trade management
Built-in toggling for 11 technical indicators and multi-timeframe chart switching, combining trading with technical analysis in one interface
cons: 代码存在大量重复，6个品种的点击事件处理几乎完全复制粘贴，缺乏循环抽象
界面按钮名称使用俄语编码导致乱码，严重影响代码可读性和国际化兼容性
缺少输入验证和错误处理，交易操作未检查返回结果，可能导致静默失败
cons_en: Massive code duplication - the click event handlers for all 6 symbols are nearly identical copy-paste blocks with no loop abstraction
Button names use Russian encoding causing garbled text, severely impacting code readability and internationalization compatibility
Lacks input validation and error handling - trade operations do not check return values, potentially causing silent failures
improvements: 使用数组循环替代6个品种的重复代码块，大幅减少代码冗余
添加交易操作的错误检查和重试机制，确保操作可靠性
improvements_en: Replace the 6 repeated symbol click handler blocks with array-based loops to drastically reduce code redundancy
Add error checking and retry mechanisms for trade operations to ensure reliability

risk_points: 交易操作缺少错误检查和返回值验证，可能导致操作失败但用户不知情
利润自动平仓功能（USEProfitCLOSE）在OnTick中持续触发，可能造成意外平仓
手数调整按钮每次仅增减0.01，但未限制最大手数，存在误操作风险
risk_points_en: Trade operations lack error checking and return value validation, potentially causing silent operation failures unknown to the user
The profit auto-close feature (USEProfitCLOSE) triggers continuously in OnTick, potentially causing unintended position closures
Lot size adjustment buttons only increment/decrement by 0.01 with no maximum lot limit, posing risk of accidental oversizing

summary_en: VirtualTradePad is a multi-function trading panel/dashboard EA for MT5 that provides a graphical interface for manual trading operations including opening/closing positions, placing pending orders, trailing stops, and monitoring account info across up to 6 symbols. It does not generate its own trade signals but instead offers button-driven controls for the trader to execute trades manually from the chart.
